label: Structured W256 self-attention - 2x1s input / 2x1s output x59 - layer 2 hidden512 near-identity hindsight readout - variance +0.01 at reconstruction corr >= 2^(-1/3600) - pure Gaussian validation - 256k - equal batch 10240 - EMA4

architecture.numberedLayerSharing: each parenthesized number is one exact shared module reused at every matching block; layer 2 is one shared near-identity hindsight-conditioned readout, layer 8 is causal self-attention, and other numbered layers remain GNGLUs
architecture.initialState: the first observed W embedding seeds M and P with two unnumbered GNGLUs; shared layer 3 produces F and shared layer 4 produces PF
architecture.outputState: shared layer 7 maps PF to NF; shared layer 8 causally self-attends over generated NF states to emit W; only shared layer 2 receives W plus the matching noisy future O59 row and noise variance. No noisy values or variance enter attention, recurrent states, or other numbered layers.
architecture.latentSemantics: P, F, PF, and NF remain unconstrained latent embeddings in this experiment; no probability decoder or density loss is imposed

hindsightConditioning.source: per-output-step noisy standardized future feature state and scalar variance, supplied only to shared final layer 2
hindsightConditioning.readout: a * noisy_features + b * GNGLU(concat(expected_feature_embedding, noisy_features, variance)); a and b are learnable per-feature gains

loss.description: mean MSE over both predicted output steps and all 59 feature channels after per-feature training-split standardization

hindsightNoiseSchedule.advance: check once after each complete epoch; if threshold met, increment variance once for the next epoch, capped at 1; otherwise hold indefinitely within the run epoch budget
hindsightNoiseSchedule.prediction: clean standardized features in one forward pass; no iterative denoising

sampling.description: original dense chronological clean-origin dataset with exact-zero next-return targets excluded
sampling.comparisonControl: fresh initialization; same dataset, structured and attention widths, optimizer, feature-MSE objective, passthrough gains and correlation-gated curriculum as predecessorPlanId; only layer-2 correction hidden width increases from default 187 to 512. Separately record held-out current-noise reconstruction; it never controls the gate or selects checkpoints.

evaluation.headline: step-1 next completed 1s signed log return
evaluation.checkpointSelection: pure-noise validation step-1 next-return MSE and correlation; test never selects
evaluation.hindsight: All forecast evaluations use variance 1 and fixed split-specific Gaussian streams independent of targets. The training-only current-noise reconstruction probe controls the curriculum. A separate current-noise validation reconstruction diagnostic uses raw weights and a distinct seed; it does not affect the curriculum, loss, or checkpoint selection.

alignment.input: two consecutive timeline rows ending at each clean example origin
alignment.target: the two complete chronological timeline rows at origin+1 and origin+2
alignment.futureExtension: K1 uses consecutive rows ending at origin; K2 uses consecutive rows starting at origin+1
alignment.attentionCausality: output step s attends only to generated NF states at output steps <= s
alignment.hindsight: each noisy future token is visible only to the matching final layer-2 readout. Changing any noisy token or variance leaves all W/M/P/F/PF/NF trajectories unchanged; decoded outputs are not fed back into the recurrence.
